Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the atlas binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. A 168 account operation therefore ties up 35 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
